title: K-injective representative of the closed-test derived mate
statement: For the coefficient ring, affine closed-fibre square, w-contractible test and supplied K-injective representatives in [def-sfb-closed-test-chain-mate-data], the localized ordinary chainMate followed by pushModel on the chosen target representative equals the specified derived exchange of [def-sfb-closed-test-derived-exchange-maps] after the source pushModel and exact closed-pullback factors. This is only the derived-exchange conjunct, independently of its section evaluation or localized-restriction normalization.

source.place: Tag 09BL, lemma-closed-immersion-affines-apply; derived.tex Tag 09T5, lemma-derived-adjoint-functors, and sites-cohomology.tex Tag 0D6E, lemma-derived-pushforward-composition; agent unit–counit calculation, returned proof steps 5–7.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-closed-test-kinjective-section-models] to $\mathcal I$ and $j$. It identifies the source and target derived objects with $Q(s^*f_*\mathcal I)$ and $Q((f_Z)_*\mathcal J)$, respectively, before evaluation. Apply [lem-sfb-resolving-derived-adjunction-normalization] to the specified adjunctions for $f$ and $f_Z$. Since their left adjoints are exact, all complexes form a left resolving class and their left comparison is the exact localization identification. At the K-injective $\mathcal I$, the derived counit is consequently represented by $\varepsilon_{f,\mathcal I}$. The ordinary $f_Z$-adjunct of $e$ is $j\circ h^*\varepsilon_{f,\mathcal I}\circ\theta$, by naturality of the Hom bijection and the defining adjunct of the square mate. The cited normalized derived Hom bijection sends $Q(e)$ to the class of this adjunct, followed by the inverse of $Q(j)$ to identify $Q\mathcal J$ with $h^*K$. The result is exactly $h^*\varepsilon_f\circ\theta$. Uniqueness of adjuncts proves the derived-exchange claim.

theorem closed_test_chain_exchange_normalization
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (a : Ideal A)
    {X XZ : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine X] (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of A))
    (h : XZ ⟶ X) (fZ : XZ ⟶ Spec (.of (A ⧸ a)))
    (w : IsPullback h fZ f (closedMap A a))
    (V : (Spec (.of (A ⧸ a))).AffineProEt)
    [IsWContractibleRing Γ(V.left, ⊤)]
    [IsWContractibleRing Γ((liftedTest A a V).left, ⊤)]
    (K : DerivedCategory.Plus
      (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ X)))
    (L : CochainComplex
      (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ X)) ℤ)
    [L.IsKInjective] (e : DerivedCategory.Q.obj L ≅ K.obj)
    (J : CochainComplex
      (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology XZ) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ XZ)) ℤ)
    [J.IsKInjective] (j : (complexes (CondensedRing.upperStar Λ h)).obj L ⟶ J)
    [QuasiIso j] :
    HEq (DerivedCategory.Q.map (chainMate Λ w.toCommSq L J j) ≫
        pushModel Λ fZ ((CondensedRing.upperStar Λ h).mapDerivedCategory.obj K.obj)
          J (pullRepresentative Λ h K.obj L e J j))
      ((CondensedRing.upperStar Λ (closedMap A a)).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.inv.app
          ((complexes (CondensedRing.lowerStar Λ f)).obj L) ≫
        (CondensedRing.upperStar Λ (closedMap A a)).mapDerivedCategory.map
          (pushModel Λ f K.obj L e) ≫
        (ClosedTestDerivedExchangeModel.exchange Λ w.toCommSq).app K.obj)
